title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 2.00 (quiet) at 23:00 UTC on 1 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 1 日 23:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 2.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 2.00 (2Z) at 23:00 UTC on 1 October 2026. The 23:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 23:59; hour-start 2.00/2Z, hour-end 1.67/2M). Last-180 maximum is 2.00 (first at 2026-10-01T22:41:00Z; label 2Z). Published-window maximum is 2.00 (first at 2026-10-01T22:41:00Z; label 2Z). Window start 2026-10-01T18:59:00Z (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 00:00 UTC on 2 October 2026 hour is still incomplete (57 samples through 00:56).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The public feed is a rolling ~6-hour window, not a full-day archive.
evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of the most complete recent hour (23:00 UTC on 1 October 2026). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
